title: Additive Leray comparison natural under coefficient endomorphisms
statement: Let $p:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with injective resolutions in the category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F$ be a module sheaf on $Y$, and suppose $R^n p_*F=0$ for every $n>0$. For every $q\geq0$, there is an additive equivalence $e:H^q(X,p_*F)\simeq H^q(Y,F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] such that for every module endomorphism $\varphi:F\to F$ and every $x\in H^q(X,p_*F)$, $e(H^q(p_*\varphi)(x))=H^q(\varphi)(e(x))$. No scheme below $X$, restricted scalar action, or scalar-linearity assertion occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Let A be module pushforward and B be global sections on X. Positive higher-direct-image vanishing says F is A-right-acyclic. Apply quasiIso_map_of_rightAcyclic_nat to the augmentation F[0] -> I of an injective resolution: the source terms are F or zero, and the target terms are injective. Compose with singleMapHomologicalComplex to obtain the quasi-isomorphism (A F)[0] -> A I. The module pushforward injective acyclicity theorem says every term A(I^n) is B-right-acyclic. The acyclic-resolution comparison identifies R^q B(A F) with the homology of B(A I), while isoRightDerivedObj identifies R^q(A composed with B)(F) with the same homology. Compose these actual canonical isomorphisms.

For an endomorphism phi of F, lift phi to the chosen injective resolution by InjectiveResolution.desc. The lift commutes with the augmentation, and naturality of singleMapHomologicalComplex gives the corresponding square after A. Apply acyclicComparison_naturality to B and isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality to A composed with B. Cancel the acyclic comparison inverse and compose the two squares. This is the private proved helper acyclic_composite_comparison; it supplies an isomorphism commuting with every phi.

Forget scalars from this module-valued comparison. Compose with the inverse of the natural sections-resolution comparison R^q Gamma(Y,-) -> R^q(A composed with B). Functor.map_comp and naturality of that comparison yield a natural additive comparison between module-derived cohomology of A F on X and F on Y.

Obtain the natural additive moduleCohomology-to-H comparisons on X and Y. Compose the inverse of the comparison on X, the preceding additive isomorphism, and the comparison on Y. Apply their naturality equations in succession to prove the displayed equality for every endomorphism and every x. All operations apply in degree zero and to zero coefficients and empty schemes; the unit route is unchanged.

proof_origin.note: Direct acyclic-resolution proof using canonical comparisons and their naturality; no topological Leray spectral sequence or abelian higher-direct-image comparison is needed. The source-model comparison remains encapsulated in lem-sc-module-cohomology-source-comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_addEquiv_H_pushforward_natural_of_higherDirectImage_vanishing
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) [HasInjectiveResolutions Y.Modules]
    (F : Y.Modules)
    (hF : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero ((higherDirectImage p q).obj F)) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ((pushforward p).obj F).H q ≃+ F.H q,
      ∀ (φ : F ⟶ F) (x : ((pushforward p).obj F).H q),
        e (H.map ((pushforward p).map φ) q x) = H.map φ q (e x)
